P2.1.text: Drug Products Storage & Distribution | Azenta Life Sciences

P2.2.text: Trust your drug and cell therapy products to the premier name in ultra-cold storage. Azenta prioritizes flexible pharmaceutical logistics and distribution!

P2.4.text: Maintaining Secure Cold Chain Logistics, Every Step of the Way

P2.5.text: Trust your manufactured drug products with the premier name in ultra-cold storage. Our capabilities range from storage and cold chain logistics management to pharmaceutical distribution of drug products in their journey from development through commercialization. Azenta Life Sciences understands the challenges that drug manufacturers like pharmaceutical companies and CDMOs face – starting with ultra-cold temperature environments. Manufactured drug products have rigorous cold storage standards, with specific needs, which are critical for the efficacy and shelf life of temperature-sensitive drugs. Adherence to these requirements can be very challenging, especially when the products need to be transported from/to various points-of-use

P2.6.text: Our experts specialize in cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) controlled cold chain storage as well as cold chain management to help safeguard the integrity and quality of your indispensable products. From ambient temperature to our core competency in ultra-cold storage – we maintain secure cold chain logistics, every step of the way.

P2.7.text: Rapid retrieval as fast as 24 hours for shipment across the globe.

P2.8.text: End-to-end logistics including transport in our mobile biorepositories in the US to maintain chain of custody for bulk shipments.

P2.9.text: Our own automated stores are available for additional layer of controlled cold chain management.

P2.10.text: 24/7 access to material data through secure software that supports 21 CFR, part 11 compliance, providing real-time visibility to inventory and complete audit trail.

P2.11.text: Quality management system (QMS) built to be compliant with the stringent requirements of GxP and 150+ unwavering best practices for regulated storage and logistics.

P2.12.text: State-of-the-art cGMP, GDP, and GTP-compliant short- and long-term storage ranging from ambient to -196°C.

P2.16.text: Automated storage systems from Azenta allow flexible storage for a variety of labware and rapid access. These systems are available throughout our biorepositories to help minimize risk and support consistent and traceable handling of materials including an audit trail of all movements for an additional layer of visibility.

P2.17.text: All your materials stored with Azenta are managed within the Limfinity ® Sample Management System which enables our team to efficiently manage your inventory and to always have visibility. Our software supports 21 CFR, part 11 compliance and provides secure audit trail reporting, flexible tracking, and web-based retrieval and shipping.

P2.19.text: Accredited as a Drug Distributor by the NABP, Azenta holds licenses to distribute from our Indiana facility to all states and outlying territories of the United States
